verdicts.why: Row 何ですか glossed 'what is it?' but the seed renders it as the contraction "what's" (LEGO L2 = what's), so the gloss is an uncontracted/expanded form of a word in the sentence.
ಇದೆ glossed 'is' but the seed "I'm busy tomorrow night" has no separate 'is'; it is folded into the contraction "I'm".
'did...have...spend' is a discontiguous gloss of ಕಳೀತಾ; the seed has "Did you have a good time" with 'spend' not rendered.
ಮೇಲೆ 'on' is a literal gloss; the seed renders ಹುಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ as 'across the grass' and 'on' does not appear, though the row concerns this position.
'wake' is the lemma of 'woke' in "I woke earlier than I wanted to".
ಅಂತ 'that' is a particle the seed "I'm not sure when I'll be ready" does not render.
'to open' vs seed "she can open the door": 'open' is present but the infinitive 'to' is not.
ಅಂತ 'that' is a particle the seed "He wanted to know what was happening a week ago" does not render.
'its meaning' is a literal gloss of ಅದರ ಅರ್ಥ, which the seed renders as "that doesn't mean"; the row is about its sentence's LEGO.
ಇದೆ 'is' is folded into "I'm" in the seed "I'm sorry but I'm too busy today".
'to reach' vs seed "couldn't reach the top": 'reach' is present, the infinitive 'to' is not.
ಹಾಗೆ 'like' is not rendered in "Nothing seems to be working"; it belongs to the LEGO's 'seems to' construction.
'to provide' vs seed "She can't provide all the answers": 'provide' is present, the infinitive 'to' is not.
ಅಂತ 'that' is a particle the seed "No I didn't think she was right" does not render.
